signal_execution_timing.signal_generation: causal features at bar t using close(t) and history ≤ t
signal_execution_timing.position_mapping: apply_holding: non-zero signal at i fills positions[i:i+h]
signal_execution_timing.implication: Position decided using information through close(t-1) earns the subsequent close(t-1)→close(t) return. Equivalent to end-of-bar signal with next-bar realization. NOT same-bar close(t) fill of a signal that used close(t).
